tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Search the AI Find Me business directory by words (a service, product, business name or feature), category and/or city. A sentence works too: small words ("where", "buy", "the") and shop words are ignored, plurals and accents don't matter, a country named last becomes a filter, a web address finds i

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Get every fact the directory holds about one business: summary, about, category, address and map link, phone, email, opening hours (with the time zone when known), price range, cuisine, services, prices, FAQs, features such as wheelchair access or delivery, payment methods, languages, registration n

tools.name: get_products
tools.description: For a web shop: the shop facts (platform, categories, price range, currency, number of products, shipping countries, delivery time, free-shipping threshold, return period, review profiles, trust marks) and a sample of its products with name, price, stock, link and image, as the shop publishes them.

tools.name: list_new_listings
tools.description: Businesses newly listed in the directory since a date (default: the last 7 days, at most 90 days back), newest first, with their listing date; kind "shop" keeps the web shops, country (NL, BE, GB or US) one country. Poll it to learn about new shops and businesses; get_business and get_products give

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the directory categories with their keys (for the category argument of search_businesses) and how many businesses each has.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the cities that have listings, most listings first, with the value to pass as the city argument of search_businesses. Optionally only cities with listings in one category.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_business, get_products · Public sink: get_business.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_business, get_products · Public sink: get_business

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
